title: Named projections of the existing normalized completion representative
statement: For a derived scalar cochain model F and fixed completion models and exchange, RepresentativeComparison.val is the existing subtype value, and RepresentativeComparison.property is its existing pair of quotient and counit normalization equations [lem-pur-finite-free-completion-exchange]. Naming these projections lets clients keep the large subtype definition locally irreducible. No new data, property, or choice is introduced.
